integrity: The analytic proof and stand-alone reproducibility program are included. No independent audit was performed. The previously published general random-probing moment framework and triangle Hamiltonian are acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Exact variance concerns the number of ideal detection attempts, not elapsed time; the general theorem requires simple energies and equal nonzero detector weights, exponential independent waiting times, and finite Hilbert dimension. Exceptional triangle fluxes are separately reduced. No priority certification is asserted.
title: Poisson quantum-return variance as an inverse-gap spectral sum
